__comment__: Template of /opt/meshcentral-preview/meshcentral-data/config.json, the preview instance's MeshCentral config (preview.high.support). Never a real config: it holds no secret.

Settings are production's non-secret settings (tools/duplicate_server/production_flags.json) with the preview substitutions: cert, agentAliasDNS and certUrl preview.high.support; port 4440 and mpsPort 4441 bound to 127.0.0.1 (production: 4430, 4433); mongoDbName meshcentral_preview; fresh keys; title. Left out: dataPath (the container passes --datapath), url, agentWebCertHashes and agentWebCertUrls (production identifiers), customFiles (the r0 canary entry is dropped after the cutover, D16).

Paths are the container's: the container mounts /opt/meshcentral-preview/meshcentral-{data,files,web,recordings,backups} at /opt/meshcentral/meshcentral-*, so backupPath /opt/meshcentral/meshcentral-backups is the host folder /opt/meshcentral-preview/meshcentral-backups.

Replace every REPLACE_ value before the first deploy; the release controller refuses the file while one is left. sessionKey, dbEncryptKey and dbRecordsEncryptKey: each a fresh value (for example openssl rand -hex 32), never production's. mongoDb: mongodb://meshcentral_preview:<password>@127.0.0.1:27017/meshcentral_preview?authSource=meshcentral_preview for a MongoDB user with readWrite on meshcentral_preview only.
Checked by test/ci_release_preview_instance_test.py against release_manager.INSTANCES['preview'] and production_flags.json.
